primary.derived_summary_under200words: The paper trains three lookahead-distance bias vectors shared across starting RVQ positions: 3,072 parameters, implying 1,024 elements each. Backbone, embeddings and existing heads remain frozen. Offsets affect proposals only; sparse tree verification uses ancestor attention and rejection/residual sampling. Training/validation use separate VoxPopuli subsets; LibriSpeech calibrates tree shape; multilingual Fleurs evaluates acceptance and error. Experiments use Qwen3-TTS-0.6B CustomVoice, W8A16 and Apple Neural Engine single-stream inference. The reported 2–2.2× concerns RVQ token generation, not our full Omni service. Public SDK deployment is reported, but the paper does not directly link standalone offset-training code or bias checkpoints.

availability.scope_caveat: Not proof of absence globally. Public inference SDK and compiled base CoreML bundles are available; these do not establish release of this paper implementation or standalone trained biases.

public_sdk.finding: Inspected public MultiCodeDecoder has sequential generation; no speculative/tree/Medusa/rejection code matches. offsetId refers to codebook vocabulary indexing, not learned lookahead biases.

public_model_listing.finding: Lists CoreML W8A16 decoder bundles; no named speculative/offset/draft/tree/Medusa asset. No binary weights downloaded or inspected.

availability.search: Paper links followed to official SDK; official organization repository listing, SDK recursive tree, decoder source and HF model metadata checked. Generic search found paper mirrors, not a primary standalone implementation.

local_transfer_risks_inferences: Our checkpoint is Omni30B-A3B end-to-end streaming, BF16 on two L20X and C1..64; identical1024 bias shape would not make TTS-trained bias weights portable. Fit only against our frozen predictor and immutable versioned normalization/filter contract.

Current stored sampler applies top_k50 then top_p.8. Tree proposal selection and multi-candidate rejection must implement this target distribution, including ties/zero support and FP64 normalization choices; do not copy claimed top-k exactness into our finite-precision contract.

Tree query/head shapes may change BF16 logits. Existing compiled B64 vstride mismatch .46875/argmax0 is a specific warning: strict verifier parity must precede timing, and argmax agreement alone is insufficient.

C64 tree expansion can increase compute/memory traffic and padding, with per-row divergent accepted lengths and cache rollback. Node budgets must be measured separately atC1/C64, not inferred from Apple single-stream.
Any latency reduction applies only to the measured predictor component until full pipeline TTFA/RTF/throughput and quality are tested. No use of paper2x as local gain.
data_requirements: Create new provenance-tracked training corpus, disjoint validation corpus, separate tree calibration corpus and untouched held-out acceptance/quality evaluation. Freeze utterance/speaker/source split and detect near-duplicates before tuning.

Do NOT train biases, select checkpoints, choose tree shape/node budget or tune acceptance thresholds on existing frozen256 benchmark or its64 captured rows. Those captures already informed research; use fresh held-out evaluation for unbiased candidate assessment, then frozen campaign only as final regression gate.

Train only3x1024 biases with backbone/head frozen; no training authorized or executed. Record objective, seeds, data licenses/hashes, model hash and bias hash. Validate free-running histories, not merely teacher-forced overlap.
Require verifier numerical tests, independent sampling oracle including tree branch probability/zero-support cases, and held-out speech quality before any service pilot.
artifacts_downloaded: Only HTML/API metadata and ~31KB public Swift source read; no large model files, no training, no GPU, no performance files modified
